entities.summary: Ismail Mohamed Asif Waheed is a Maldivian sprinter. Waheed competed at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, South Korea, representing Maldives in three men's athletics events. He was one of the first Maldivian athletes to compete at an Olympic Games as the nation had made their first appearance at these Summer Games.
